newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Marubeni group vies for Manila power plant.
newsitem.headline: Marubeni group vies for Manila power plant.

text.p: A consortium composed of Marubeni Corp, Sithe Energies of the U.S. and Italian-Thai Development was the lone bidder for the construction of a 345-megawatt powerplant, National Power Corp said on Wednesday.

In a memorandum to Energy Minister Francisco Viray, National Power Corp (Napocor) President Guido Delgado said Marubeni-Sithe and Italian-Thai who were separately prequalified decided to submit a joint bid for the hydroelectric power project.
"If the lone bid is found to be technically complying, the second envelope containing the financial requirements of the tender will be opened," Delgado said.
Results of the technical evaluation will be announcd by the end of the month.
The Napocor board is scheduled to decide on the awarding of the contract for the project on March 10.

As a multi-purpose project, the winning bidders are required to invest an estimated $1-billion for the power plant and the irrigation facilities in the town of San Roque in the province of Pangasinan, north of Manila.
